name: 15_preparatifs_taikun
scene: Conseil du Capitole — du calendrier déplié par Théo à l'accord sur le moteur et le pilotage du TAIKUN.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE complete full-screen visual novel CG, widescreen landscape 16:9, requested 1920 x 1080 pixels, opaque.
Primary request: The ENTIRE SIX-PERSON TEAM actively preparing the TAIKUN expedition plan, viewed from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER AERIAL ANGLE looking diagonally down onto them and their documents. This depicts the passage where Theo spreads a calendar, Allan explains the autonomous TAIKUN ark with homes, farms, factories and supplies, and Sofiane offers his supernatural Trueno as the future ship engine. Forty years after catastrophe, BEFORE their 999-year time jump. A hopeful working strategy session among old friends, practical cooperation, six clearly distinct identities, genuine concentration and warmth.
Input references: Image 1 is the GOVERNOR'S OFFICE location reference. Image 2 is an existing SIX-PERSON GROUP CG for FACE IDENTITIES and drawing style ONLY: from left to right Allan, Micka, Jessy, Theo, Florentin, Sofiane. It shows them in a LATER era: do NOT use its spaceship, planet, pose, military uniforms for civilians, or Jessy's long beard. Image 3 locks ALLAN'S correct present CEO suit, tie, glasses and gloves. Image 4 locks JESSY'S correct present young face, SHORT beard and plain priest robe. Image 5 locks MICKA'S correct present pinstripe governor suit and gold-patterned burgundy tie. Theo and Florentin already have the same costumes as in the group reference; Sofiane must instead wear the civilian black driving jacket described below. All six must be repainted working around the table, not reproduced in their group portrait pose.
CAMERA / COMPOSITION: a cinematic high-angle three-quarter establishing shot from an upper corner of the office, about 45-55 degrees downward, NOT a perfectly vertical flat overhead shot and NOT an eye-level group portrait. See the large tabletop clearly along a strong diagonal from near LEFT to far RIGHT; the six people are gathered around it, actively leaning in, sitting or half-standing naturally. Their bodies are foreshortened consistently with the camera; several faces visible in three-quarter view, nearest participants seen partly from the back with recognizable hair/outfits and side profiles. Nobody looks up at the camera or poses for a photo. Give every one of the six a distinct readable place. The room's curved windows, warm bronze structural ribs, dark wood floor, amber lighting and governor's desk beyond orient the viewer. The planning documents, all six heads and the main interacting hands are within the upper three quarters, while lower quarter is quieter chair backs, clothes and floor for the game's dialogue overlay. DO NOT draw an overlay. A wide enough view that no participant is cut out or hidden under another head.
EXACTLY SIX PEOPLE, one of each, matching their reference faces and clothes:
THEO: older man, short swept-back salt-and-pepper hair, neat grey moustache without a full beard, BLACK rectangular glasses, beige trench coat over charcoal ribbed turtleneck, small green creeper keychain on coat. At far-left side of the planning table, he spreads/steadies a large partially unrolled paper calendar, one hand showing an upcoming marked deadline and the other keeping its edge flat. Focused calm determination; not white-haired elderly Laplage.
ALLAN: mature silver-haired businessman, short grey beard, dark aviator SUNGLASSES, charcoal-grey THREE-PIECE SUIT, white shirt, patterned pale silver-blue tie, brown leather GLOVES, small CEO lapel pin as in image 3. Next to Theo on the far side, he uses a pen to point out sectors on the huge circular TAIKUN blueprint while explaining its residential and industrial systems. His other gloved hand braces the page, natural hands.
MICKA: mature grey-haired man with neat short grey beard, NO glasses, dark charcoal PINSTRIPE three-piece suit, white shirt, dark burgundy tie with subtle GOLD motifs, pocket square. At the head / far-right end, attentive governor reviewing a logistics sheet with a thoughtful half-smile, one hand flat on the tabletop. Clearly different face and outfit from Allan, no sunglasses or gloves.
SOFIANE: mature dark-haired man with a low short PONYTAIL, greying temples and short salt-and-pepper beard, BLACK rectangular glasses, charcoal casual DRIVING JACKET over a dark T-shirt. At the near-left side, he has set his car keys beside an existing hand-drawn drivetrain / compact engine sketch and leans toward Allan's diagram with restrained amused confidence. No tactical armor yet, no car physically in the room.
JESSY: the ONLY young-looking man, around twenty, tousled brown hair, SHORT full brown beard, BLACK rectangular glasses, plain IVORY-WHITE PRIEST ROBE with standing clerical collar. Near side toward center-right, leaning forward with both hands resting separately near a small star-route diagram, listening to the ship plan with hope and quiet resolve. NO long prophet beard, NO gem necklace, no future prophet costume.
FLORENTIN: mature light-grey-haired commander, short grey beard, BLACK rectangular glasses, distinct thin diagonal scar on his cheek, DARK GREEN / charcoal sci-fi armor coat with GOLD metallic trims and small AMBER light details, matching the armored commander in group reference 2. On the right flank of the table in side three-quarter view, studying a folded military logistics / troop deployment diagram, one armored hand near his CLOSED dark briefcase resting beside his chair. Controlled gravity, no weapons drawn, no rage or fighting in this shot.
TABLE / STORY DETAILS: a large temporary oval meeting table in dark wood and bronze in the center of this office, chairs around it, governor's desk and original architecture still visible deeper in the room. Three main groups of physical documents on tabletop: (1) the broad paper calendar with regular small calendar grids and a long horizontal timeline leading from a close deadline to a distant milestone; communicate time by diagrams and marked squares, NO readable words or numerals; (2) Allan's dominant pale BLUE technical blueprint of the annular TAIKUN, a massive thick concentric annular habitat wheel with radial spokes and an intricate central hub, clearly a thick concentric wheel with spokes and a central hub, with a few small section insets showing living quarters, GREEN crop beds, factory modules and stores, all schematic drawings, not a finished real spacecraft; (3) a modest engine/drivetrain sketch near Sofiane's single set of car keys, and the smaller route and military diagrams. A few loose plans, pens and closed folders make practical preparation believable, with the main plans laid legibly rather than a sea of arbitrary papers. Nobody holds a hologram; the focus is human collaboration over tangible plans.
LOCATION: faithfully reinterpret the SAME curved governor's office from image 1 at the new high three-quarter camera angle: wood-and-bronze panels, dark metal supports, broad curved windows, restrained cool teal side monitors, warm ceiling strip lights. Exterior glimpses of the rebuilt coastal city, pink alien vegetation, and two low suns if visible through the angle. The ceiling should NOT obstruct the elevated camera. No sci-fi war room substitution or spaceship bridge.
STYLE / MOOD: detailed illustrated anime CG, fine precise contour lines, dimensional natural adult faces and fabric, richly painted cinematic background, consistent with the existing visual novel. Soft copper-amber sunset entering across the plans, cool blue blueprint reflections, sober violet shadows. Six friends assembling an audacious shared future: hopeful, focused, mildly warm camaraderie, not posed heroic grandeur or a comedic gag. All characters repainted into a single physically coherent new scene, no pasted sprite cutouts.
Constraints: EXACTLY SIX people: Theo, Allan, Micka, Sofiane, Jessy and Florentin; no Laplage, Ilona or Alexandre, no assistants or extra silhouettes. No duplicated characters, no swapped heads/outfits, no extra limbs or fused hands. No time portal, no TARDIS, no magic glow, no real ship or planet outside. ONE independent illustration, no panels/collage, no borders, no readable text, no captions/dialogue, no UI or watermark.
export: Bicubic normalization without cropping. Native original preserved.
integration: Direct native-size image, no zoom; full-screen CG replaces background and all sprites from the calendar narration until Allan's « Accordé. », followed by the existing council scene.
